workspace.addressFormTiHint: Consistently uses direct conversational ti (ti / tebi / si)

privacy.offlineGuarantee: Audio, video, full transcripts, and API keys NEVER leave your device (unless you explicitly choose a Cloud translation API). All optional telemetry below is unchecked by default.
privacy.autoSendCrashReportsHint: Sends panic/error stack traces without API keys, usernames, or subtitle text
privacy.shareAnonymousUsageMetrics: Share anonymous performance & subtitle quality metrics

privacy.shareAnonymizedTranslationEdits: Donate anonymized edit pairs for Serbian AI training
privacy.shareAnonymizedTranslationEditsHint: Up to 25 edited cues per export with names/numbers masked as [NAME] and [NUM]
privacy.autoCheckUpdatesHint: Anonymous startup check (OS, architecture, app version only — zero IP or device ID stored)
privacy.envDisabledNotice: Telemetry & update proxy disabled by environment variable (DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or EASYSRT_TELEMETRY_URL=off).
privacy.upgradeBannerTitle: Confirm your v0.5.0 privacy & telemetry preferences
privacy.upgradeBannerBody: Telemetry is paused until you review and confirm your choices. All optional toggles below are off by default — switch on only what you are comfortable sharing.
